## Hook (first 3 seconds)
**On-screen text (opens muted):** "Our second café cost 40% more than our first. Rent wasn't why."

**Spoken:** "Our second location cost 40% more to open than our first — and it had nothing to do with rent."

## Body (3-4 scenes with cues)

**Scene 1 — The assumption (0:03–0:12)**
*Visual: you, talking, interior of the new site behind you.*
"We budgeted the second one like the first: lease, fit-out, equipment. We thought we'd done this before, so it'd be cheaper."

**Scene 2 — The real cost (0:12–0:30)**
*Visual: cut to a simple on-screen breakdown — "Rent: as planned / Staffing: 40% over."*
"Rent came in on budget. Staffing didn't. The first site, we trained everyone ourselves, on the floor, for months. The second, we weren't there — so we had to hire more senior people, pay for overlap during handover, and cover mistakes we used to catch in person."

**Scene 3 — Why it happened (0:30–0:42)**
*Visual: back to you.*
"The thing that made site one work — us being there — doesn't scale. At one location that's free labour. At two, it's a line item you forgot to budget for."

## CTA
*Visual: you, settled frame.*
"If you're opening a second site: budget the version of yourself you won't be there to replace. What's the cost you underestimated when you expanded? I'd genuinely like to hear it."
